name: Privilege Escalation Response Playbook
description: Automated response for privilege escalation events detected via Sysmon and Windows Security logs. Isolates affected host and escalates to analyst.

workflow_steps.description: Receives privilege escalation alert from Splunk
Normalises alert fields and sets severity to HIGH
Blocks all inbound and outbound traffic on affected host
workflow_steps.command: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles firewallpolicy blockinbound,blockoutbound

workflow_steps.description: Immediately disables the escalated account in Active Directory
Sends HIGH severity alert to SOC channel with immediate escalation flag

response_actions: HIGH severity escalation sent to SOC analyst
Incident ticket created for manual investigation
